method: method/ne_areas_mercator.py (python3 -I): true areas from the offices (C001, C006, C007, C004, C008); inflation factor = Mercator-drawn area / equal-area area of each Natural Earth polygon (Rajasthan 1.26, Finland 5.44, Norway 5.52, Sweden 4.85, Germany 2.54). Say 'about four times', not '4.3 times': the inflation varies across a country.
notes: This is the 'map is lying' hook. Wording: 'on a Mercator map Finland looks about four times Rajasthan'. A Mercator world map is a choice of the map-maker; the Natural Earth data here are not Mercator themselves. The script must not claim all maps do this.
